title: Elite Dangerous Trading Tools, Live Markets & Cargo Selling | Elite Nexus
description: Find buyers for your cargo, look up any commodity, pin orders and plan a run, spot abnormal prices and set live price alerts from a local market database fed by EDDN. Mining and colonisation tools included.
heading: Make every tonne count.
lead: Find a buyer for the hold you already have. Plan the next profitable run. Catch unusual prices as commanders report them. Your cargo, your ship and the community’s market data in one place.
hero_alt: Elite Nexus Market Station tab with four markets side by side, their prices against the galactic average and the best prices standing out.
hero_caption: The Station tab puts up to eight markets side by side, and the cheapest place to buy a good and the best to sell it stand out.
